title: HX, FREE? What’s the Catch? (There Isn’t One!)
excerpt: HX, FREE? What’s the catch? We’ve become so used to paying for memberships, subscriptions and platforms that even AI struggles to believe HX is genuinely free! Discover why we created a different way of doing business, where communities can thrive, opportunities are accessible to everyone, and we prosper because others prosper.
